notes.title: CHANGELOG (ver. 0.64)
Linux, Mac & Win32 Versions + Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope your enjoying Guilty Force! It has been amazing to help publish this title! Today we have new build types for players. Which include.

-macOS
-LINUX + SteamOS
-Windows32

We are testing each type out as this is a whole new arena for us working with multiple builds. So please let us know if anything isnt working so we can fix it asap so you get get out there into Guilty Force!

Also a bunch of bug fixes were dropped in all 4 versions (including the Windows64 version! Again thank you all for reporting bugs you find!

notes.title: Patch 0.63
notes.notes:
We are working on getting to each issue as fast as we can, so far we have got a new rollout for the following.

Fixed bugs/improvements:

1) Updated version of Rewired plugin for better recognition of various controller types;
2) Implemented "Reset" button in Settings to reset all settings to default.

notes.title: Controller Update & Bug Fixing!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for the feedback so far! We are working on the games fixes as fast as we can. So far we had addressed the controller issues for

-Xbox
-Playstation
-Most USB Controllers

So your controller experience should be a lot better. Hang tight as we keep gathering your feedback :)

- Shades
